name: Float level switch NC
summary: A float-operated NC level switch opens when its documented level condition actuates the mechanism.
description: A float-operated NC level switch opens when its documented level condition actuates the mechanism. Reference state and level direction must be shown for alarm or pump-control interpretation.
readingNotes: Evaluate both low-level and high-level conditions from the switch schedule.
The preview is an original explanation of this function. Match the actual drawing convention to its legend and the selected equipment documentation.
distinction: NC does not necessarily mean low-level trip; the selected mechanism defines the process action.
